gen-luckiest-guy-gf-stack-sans-notch: Stack Sans Notch reads like rod stock bent into big-bodied lowercase, with curves you can see right into. Stack Sans Notch holds the page steady while Luckiest Guy shouts above it, cheerful and poured thick.
gen-megrim-gf-tiktok-sans: TikTok Sans rises with a lowercase that nearly matches its capitals, and its c opens wide and spacious. Make Megrim small and its hairline angles thin out.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-stack-sans-text: Nostalgic and a little bookish, Mystery Quest wears open jaws on its curves and compact ascenders over tall lowercase. Stack Sans Text then runs a marker-like line with big-bodied letters, so a long passage moves along smoothly.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-alef: Chubbo looks drawn with a marker tip, every stroke carrying the same visual weight around smooth, unobstructed bends. Alef, a plain sans, keeps its curves open-ended beneath.
gen-irish-grover-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Sturdy, oversized lowercase gives Irish Grover its fun, organic look, with softly varied strokes. And Schibsted Grotesk, a plain sans, brings approachable big-eyed e and a shapes that never close in.
gen-eater-fs-technor: Dark and spiky, Eater spreads its letters wide, with thin strokes beside moderately weighty stems and short ascenders. Technor's neon-tube line is the surprise.
gen-flavors-fs-technor: Flavors towers with a stubby, pencil-stroke x-height and diagonals as hefty as its stems. Big and short is where it earns its keep, while Technor, a cool, geometric sans, hums quietly beneath.
gen-gf-funnel-display-fs-technor: Technor reads like neon tube, one steady line with barely any gap between its upper and lower case. And Funnel Display, expressive and spaghetti-like, makes a long stretch of text feel glowing and consistent.
gen-gf-goldman-fs-technor: Commanding but cool, Goldman spreads wide letters with generous clearance and a big lowercase. But Technor, a sans-serif with a soft, featureless hum, does its best work across the paragraph.
gen-gf-grandstander-fs-technor: Technor glows like neon tube, cool and geometric, with a wide channel into every bowl. Technor's steady line gives Grandstander room to be big and short, where its tall x-height and open letters earn their keep.
